title: I built a 3D Voxel MMORPG with a top-down camera using Gemini AI. It's now in Early Access! Meet SYLVAN DOMINION.
author: MoreMaybe8052
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share a game I've been working on: **Sylvan Dominion**!

It's an **MMORPG with a built-in offline mode**. If your connection drops or you run out of data, you can still jump in and keep grinding safely on your own.  
  
**Fun fact about development: I’m building this game with the help of AI models! I’ve been using Claude Haiku, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, and Gemini 3.8 Flash. So far, Gemini has been incredibly helpful in bringing this project to life.**

Just a quick heads-up: **character progress is separate between offline and multiplayer modes**. I designed it this way to keep the online side completely fair, competitive, and cheat-free! 

The best part? It’s fully **cross-platform**, meaning you can play seamlessly on **Web browsers, PC, or Mobile** while relaxing on the couch. 

Please keep in mind that the game is still **actively under development and in Early Access**. Because of this, you might run into **some bugs, especially in multiplayer mode**, and the **in-game text might still be a mix of languages** here and there. I appreciate your patience, and I will be rolling out **gradual patches and updates over time** to smooth things out! 

**Sorry for the laggy video, by the way! My PC is a bit of a potato, and trying to play and record at the same time makes it feel like it’s about to explode. 🥔💥**

For those looking to jump straight into the multiplayer action with friends, make sure to claim this redeem code:  
🎁 **EARLYACCESS11**

**Here the link:**

[**https://sylvandominion.web.id/**](https://sylvandominion.web.id/)

comments.author: Sword_Dev
comments.body: Love the design, but I think it’s worth thinking about who this game is really for.

replies.author: MoreMaybe8052
replies.body: Thanks, That’s definitely something I need to consider carefully. I’ve always wanted to make my own game **for a long time**, and thanks to vibe coding, I finally created my dream project. I don't have a clear roadmap for the future just yet, but I'm excited to figure it out along the way!

comments.author: DaedricScimitar
comments.body:
I was scrolling Reddit and saw this.

If people scroll by like I did, they might not even view it because of that. I just thought you should know.

replies.body: Thank you for your feedback, i'll fix it ASAP
